source_units.text: “When you measure out the land as an inheritance, you will set apart a first portion for the Lord, a holy part of the land, twenty-five thousand long and twenty thousand broad. It will be holy throughout all its boundaries all around.
From this, a square of five hundred by five hundred will be for a sanctuary, with an interval of fifty cubits all around it.
From this measured area you will measure a length of twenty-five thousand and a breadth of ten thousand. In it will be the sanctuary, the most holy place.
It will be land for the priests who minister in the holy place, for those who draw near to minister to the Lord. It will be a place for their houses, set apart for their sanctification.
An area twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad will belong to the Levites who minister to the house, as their possession, with cities in which to dwell.
You will give the city a possession five thousand broad and twenty-five thousand long; like the first portion of the holy areas, these will be for the whole house of Israel.

The ruler will have land on this side and that side of the first portions of the holy areas and the city’s possession, facing the first portions of the holy areas and facing the city’s possession: the parts toward the sea, and from those toward the sea toward the east. Its length will be like one of the portions, from the sea-facing boundaries, with the length extending to the eastern boundaries of the land.
It will be his possession in Israel. Israel’s rulers will no longer oppress My people, and the house of Israel will inherit the land according to their tribes.
Thus says the Lord God: Enough, rulers of Israel! Remove injustice and suffering, and practice judgment and righteousness. Take oppression away from My people, says the Lord God.
You are to have an honest balance, an honest measure, and an honest choenix.
The measure and the choenix will likewise have one capacity: the choenix a tenth of the gomor, and the measure a tenth of the gomor. They will be equal in relation to the gomor.
The standard weight will be twenty obols. The five shekels will be five, the ten shekels ten, and fifty shekels will make your mina.
This is the first portion you will set apart: a sixth of the measure from the gomor of wheat, and a sixth of the oiphi from the kor of barley.
The command for oil is a cotyle of oil from ten cotyles, because ten cotyles are a gomor.
One sheep from every ten sheep will be a contribution from all Israel’s families, for sacrifices, burnt offerings, and offerings for well-being, to make atonement for you, says the Lord God.
All the people will give this first portion to Israel’s ruler.

Through the ruler will come the burnt offerings, sacrifices, and libations at the festivals, new moons, and Sabbaths, and at all the festivals of the house of Israel. He will provide the offerings for sin, the sacrifice, the burnt offerings, and the offerings for well-being to make atonement for the house of Israel.
Thus says the Lord God: In the first month, on the first of the month, you all will take an unblemished calf from the cattle to make atonement for the holy place.

The priest will take some of the blood of the atonement offering and put it on the house’s doorposts, on the four corners of the sacred precinct, on the altar, and on the doorposts of the gate of the inner court.
You will do likewise in the seventh month, on the first of the month: you will take a portion from each, and you all will make atonement for the house.
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, you will have the Passover festival; for seven days you will eat unleavened bread.
On that day the ruler will provide a calf for sin on behalf of himself, the house, and all the people of the land.
For the seven days of the festival, he will provide burnt offerings to the Lord: seven calves and seven unblemished rams each day for the seven days, and a goat kid each day for sin.
You will provide an offering of a cake for each calf and a cake for each ram, with a hin of oil for each cake.
In the seventh month, on the fifteenth of the month, at the festival you will provide the same for seven days: the offerings for sin, the burnt offerings, the grain offering, and the oil.”
“Thus says the Lord God: The gate in the inner court facing east will be shut during the six working days, but on the Sabbath day it will be opened, and on the day of the new moon it will be opened.

The ruler will enter by the porch of the outer gate and stand at the gate’s vestibules. The priests will offer his burnt offerings and his offerings for well-being. He will bow down at the gate’s vestibule and go out, and the gate will certainly not be shut until evening.
The people of the land will bow down before the Lord at the vestibules of that gate on Sabbaths and new moons.
The ruler will present burnt offerings to the Lord: on the Sabbath day, six unblemished lambs and an unblemished ram,
with a grain offering of a cake for the ram, and for the lambs an offering as the gift of his hand, with a hin of oil for each cake.
On the day of the new moon there will be an unblemished calf and six lambs, and the ram will be unblemished.
A cake for the ram and a cake for the calf will be the grain offering, and for the lambs whatever his hand can produce, with a hin of oil for each cake.
When the ruler enters, he will enter by the porch of the gate and go out by the way of the gate.

When the people of the land come before the Lord at the festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to bow down will go out by the south gate, and whoever enters by the south gate will go out by the north gate. He will not return through the gate by which he entered, but will go out straight opposite it.
The ruler will be among them: when they enter, he will enter with them, and when they go out, he will go out.
At the festivals and public assemblies the grain offering will be a cake for each calf, a cake for each ram, and for the lambs whatever his hand can produce, with a hin of oil for each cake.

If the ruler makes a pledged offering, a burnt offering for well-being to the Lord, he will open for himself the gate facing east and offer his burnt offering and his offerings for well-being as he does on the Sabbath day. He will go out and close the doors after he has gone out.
He will prepare an unblemished year-old lamb as a daily burnt offering to the Lord; in the morning he will prepare it.
In the morning he will prepare with it a grain offering of a sixth of the measure and a third of a hin of oil to mix the fine flour: a grain offering to the Lord, a permanent command.
You all will prepare the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil; you all will prepare them in the morning as a continual burnt offering.
Thus says the Lord God: If the ruler gives one of his sons a gift from his inheritance, this will belong to his sons as an inherited possession.
If he gives a gift to one of his servants, it will belong to him until the year of release, and he will return it to the ruler. But the inheritance of his sons will belong to them.

The ruler will certainly not take from the people’s inheritance to oppress them. He will give his sons an inheritance from his own possession, so that none of My people is scattered from his possession.”
He brought me into the entrance behind the gate, into the north-facing recessed chamber of the priests’ holy places. Look—there was a separated place there.

He said to me, “This is the place where the priests will boil the offerings for ignorance and for sin, and there bake the entire grain offering, so as not to carry it out into the outer court and sanctify the people.”
He brought me out into the outer court and led me around its four sides. Look—a court at one side of the court, and a court at another side of the court!
At the four sides of the court was a small court, forty cubits long and thirty cubits broad; the four had one measure.
There were recessed chambers all around them, around the four, with kitchens made underneath the recessed chambers all around.
He said to me, “These are the kitchen houses, where those ministering to the house will boil the people’s sacrificial animals.”

He brought me to the house’s vestibules, and look—water was flowing out beneath the open court toward the east, for the house’s front faced east. The water was descending from the right side, from the south toward the altar.
He brought me out by the north gate and led me around outside to the court’s gate facing east. Look—the water was flowing down from the right side.
As the man went out opposite, with a measure in his hand, he measured a thousand with the measure and went through the water—water of release.
He measured a thousand and went through water up to the thighs. He measured a thousand and went through water up to the waist.
He measured a thousand and could not go through, for the water surged violently like the rush of a torrent that they will not cross.
He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man?” Then he led me to the river’s edge.
As I returned, look—very many trees were on the river’s edge, on both sides.
He said to me, “This water flowing out into eastern Galilee was descending into Arabia and coming as far as the sea, to the water of the outlet; it will heal the waters.

Every life among the swarming living creatures will live wherever the river comes. There will be very many fish there, because this water has arrived there, and it will become healthy and live. Everything over which the river comes will live.
Fishers will stand there from Aingadin to Ainagalim; there will be a drying place for nets. It will be by itself, and its fish will be like the fish of the Great Sea, an exceedingly great multitude.
At its outlet, at its turning, and at its overflow, they will certainly not be healed; they are given over to salt.

Along the river, on its edge on both sides, every edible tree will grow. Nothing upon it will grow old, nor will its fruit fail. In its newness it will bear its first crop, because these waters flow from the holy places. Their fruit will be for food and their growth for health.
Thus says the Lord God: These are the boundaries of the land you will allot as an inheritance to the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel—an addition of a measured portion.
You will inherit it, each like his brother, the land for which I raised My hand to give it to their fathers. This land will fall to you as an inheritance.
These are the boundaries of the land toward the north: from the Great Sea, descending and dividing at the entrance of Hamath—Seddada,
Berotha, Sebraim, Heliam, between the boundaries of Damascus and the boundaries of Hamath, the court of Saunan, which are above the boundaries of Auranitis.
These are the boundaries from the sea, from the court of Ainan, the boundaries of Damascus, and the parts toward the north.
The eastern parts lie between Auranitis and Damascus, and between Galaaditis and the land of Israel; the Jordan marks the boundary as far as the sea east of Palm Grove. These are the eastern parts.
The parts toward the south and southwest run from Thaiman and Palm Grove to the water of Marimoth Kades, extending to the Great Sea. This is the south and southwest side.
This is the side of the Great Sea: it forms the boundary as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath, as far as its entrance. These are the sea-facing parts of Hamath.
You will divide this land for them, for the tribes of Israel.

You will cast lots for it for yourselves and for the sojourners dwelling among you who have fathered sons among you. They will be to you as native-born among the sons of Israel; with you they will eat from an inheritance among Israel’s tribes.
They will be in a tribe of sojourners, among the sojourners who are with them; there you will give them an inheritance, says the Lord God.

These are the names of the tribes: from the northern beginning, along the side of the descending, dividing way toward the entrance of Hamath, the court of Ainan, the boundary of Damascus toward the north, along the side of Hamath’s court; the eastern parts as far as the sea will belong to them—Dan, one portion.
From Dan’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Asher, one portion.
From Asher’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Naphtali, one portion.
From Naphtali’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Manasseh, one portion.
From Manasseh’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Ephraim, one portion.
From Ephraim’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Reuben, one portion.
From Reuben’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Judah, one portion.

From Judah’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts, will be the first portion set apart, twenty-five thousand in breadth, with a length like one of the portions from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts. The holy place will be in their midst.
The first portion they set apart for the Lord will be twenty-five thousand long and twenty-five thousand broad.

From these will be the first portion of the holy areas for the priests: twenty-five thousand toward the north, a breadth of ten thousand toward the sea, a breadth of ten thousand toward the east, and a length of twenty-five thousand toward the south. The mountain of the holy places will be in its midst,
for the consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok, who keep the duties of the house and did not stray when the sons of Israel strayed, as the Levites strayed.
They will have the first portion given from the land’s first portions, most holy, from the Levites’ boundaries.
The Levites will have the land adjoining the priests’ boundaries, twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad. The whole length will be twenty-five thousand and the breadth twenty thousand.
None of it will be sold or measured out, nor will the land’s first produce be taken away, for it is holy to the Lord.
The five thousand remaining in breadth alongside the twenty-five thousand will be a forewall for the city, for dwelling and its intervening space. The city will be in its midst.

These are its measurements: on the north, four thousand five hundred; on the south, four thousand five hundred; on the east, four thousand five hundred; and toward the sea, four thousand five hundred.
The city will have an intervening space: two hundred fifty toward the north, two hundred fifty toward the south, two hundred fifty toward the east, and two hundred fifty toward the sea.

The remaining length adjoining the first portions of the holy areas will be ten thousand toward the east and ten thousand toward the sea; these will be the holy place’s first portions, and its produce will be bread for the city’s workers.
The city’s workers, from all Israel’s tribes, will work it.
The entire first portion will be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You will set apart its holy portion as a square, from the city’s possession.

The remainder will belong to the ruler on this side and that side, from the holy first portions and toward the city’s possession, extending twenty-five thousand in length to the eastern boundaries, and toward the sea extending twenty-five thousand to the sea-facing boundaries, adjoining the ruler’s portions. The first portion of the holy areas and the house’s sanctuary will be in its midst.
From the Levites’ possession and from the city’s possession, it will be in the midst of the rulers; between Judah’s boundaries and Benjamin’s boundaries it will belong to the rulers.
As for the remaining tribes, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Benjamin, one portion.
From Benjamin’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Simeon, one portion.
From Simeon’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Issachar, one portion.
From Issachar’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Zebulun, one portion.
From Zebulun’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Gad, one portion.
From Gad’s boundaries toward the southwest, its boundaries will run from Thaiman and the water of Marimoth Kades, an inheritance as far as the Great Sea.
This is the land you will cast lots for among Israel’s tribes, and these are their divisions, says the Lord God.
These are the city’s outlets toward the north: four thousand five hundred by measure.
The city’s gates will bear the names of Israel’s tribes. Three gates will face north: one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, and one gate of Levi.
Toward the east, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, and one gate of Dan.
Toward the south, four thousand five hundred by measure, with three gates: one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, and one gate of Zebulun.
Toward the sea, four thousand five hundred by measure, with three gates: one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, and one gate of Naphtali.
The circuit will be eighteen thousand. And the city’s name, from whatever day it comes into being, will be its name.”

units.Ezekiel 48:11: for the consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok, who keep the duties of the house and did not stray when the sons of Israel strayed, as the Levites strayed.
units.Ezekiel 48:12: They will have the first portion given from the land’s first portions, most holy, from the Levites’ boundaries.
units.Ezekiel 48:13: The Levites will have the land adjoining the priests’ boundaries, twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad. The whole length will be twenty-five thousand and the breadth twenty thousand.
units.Ezekiel 48:14: None of it will be sold or measured out, nor will the land’s first produce be taken away, for it is holy to the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 48:15: The five thousand remaining in breadth alongside the twenty-five thousand will be a forewall for the city, for dwelling and its intervening space. The city will be in its midst.
units.Ezekiel 48:16: These are its measurements: on the north, four thousand five hundred; on the south, four thousand five hundred; on the east, four thousand five hundred; and toward the sea, four thousand five hundred.
units.Ezekiel 48:17: The city will have an intervening space: two hundred fifty toward the north, two hundred fifty toward the south, two hundred fifty toward the east, and two hundred fifty toward the sea.
units.Ezekiel 48:18: The remaining length adjoining the first portions of the holy areas will be ten thousand toward the east and ten thousand toward the sea; these will be the holy place’s first portions, and its produce will be bread for the city’s workers.
units.Ezekiel 48:19: The city’s workers, from all Israel’s tribes, will work it.
units.Ezekiel 48:20: The entire first portion will be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You will set apart its holy portion as a square, from the city’s possession.
units.Ezekiel 48:21: The remainder will belong to the ruler on this side and that side, from the holy first portions and toward the city’s possession, extending twenty-five thousand in length to the eastern boundaries, and toward the sea extending twenty-five thousand to the sea-facing boundaries, adjoining the ruler’s portions. The first portion of the holy areas and the house’s sanctuary will be in its midst.
units.Ezekiel 48:22: From the Levites’ possession and from the city’s possession, it will be in the midst of the rulers; between Judah’s boundaries and Benjamin’s boundaries it will belong to the rulers.
units.Ezekiel 48:23: As for the remaining tribes, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Benjamin, one portion.
units.Ezekiel 48:24: From Benjamin’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Simeon, one portion.
units.Ezekiel 48:25: From Simeon’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Issachar, one portion.
units.Ezekiel 48:26: From Issachar’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Zebulun, one portion.
units.Ezekiel 48:27: From Zebulun’s boundaries, from the eastern parts to the sea-facing parts—Gad, one portion.
units.Ezekiel 48:28: From Gad’s boundaries toward the southwest, its boundaries will run from Thaiman and the water of Marimoth Kades, an inheritance as far as the Great Sea.
units.Ezekiel 48:29: This is the land you will cast lots for among Israel’s tribes, and these are their divisions, says the Lord God.
units.Ezekiel 48:30: These are the city’s outlets toward the north: four thousand five hundred by measure.
units.Ezekiel 48:31: The city’s gates will bear the names of Israel’s tribes. Three gates will face north: one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, and one gate of Levi.
units.Ezekiel 48:32: Toward the east, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, and one gate of Dan.
units.Ezekiel 48:33: Toward the south, four thousand five hundred by measure, with three gates: one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, and one gate of Zebulun.
units.Ezekiel 48:34: Toward the sea, four thousand five hundred by measure, with three gates: one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, and one gate of Naphtali.
units.Ezekiel 48:35: The circuit will be eighteen thousand. And the city’s name, from whatever day it comes into being, will be its name.”
units.Ezekiel 42:13: He said to me, “The recessed chambers toward the north and toward the south, facing the intervening spaces, are the chambers of the holy place. There the priests, the sons of Zadok who draw near to the Lord, will eat the most holy things. There they will place the most holy things—the offering, the offerings for sin, and the offerings for ignorance—for the place is holy.
units.Ezekiel 42:14: No one will enter there except the priests. They will not go out from the holy place into the outer court, so that those who bring offerings may always be holy and may not touch the garments in which they minister, for they are holy. They will put on other garments whenever they come into contact with the people.”
units.Ezekiel 42:15: The measurement of the house inside was completed. He brought me out by the gate facing east and measured the plan of the house all around in its arrangement.
units.Ezekiel 42:16: He stood behind the gate facing east and measured five hundred with the measuring reed.
units.Ezekiel 42:17: He turned toward the north and measured the north-facing side: five hundred cubits with the measuring reed.
units.Ezekiel 42:18: He turned toward the sea and measured the sea-facing side: five hundred with the measuring reed.
units.Ezekiel 42:19: He turned toward the south and measured opposite the south: five hundred with the measuring reed.
units.Ezekiel 42:20: The four sides were measured with the same reed. He laid it out, with their enclosure all around: five hundred toward the east and five hundred cubits in breadth, to distinguish between the holy areas and the forewall in the arrangement of the house.
units.Ezekiel 43:18: He said to me, “Son of man, thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: These are the altar’s commands on the day it is made, for offering burnt offerings on it and pouring blood against it.
units.Ezekiel 43:19: You will give the Levitical priests who are of Zadok’s offspring and draw near to Me to minister to Me, says the Lord God, a calf from the cattle as an offering for sin.
units.Ezekiel 43:20: They will take some of its blood and put it on the altar’s four horns, on the four corners of the place of atonement, and on the base all around. They will make atonement for it.
units.Ezekiel 43:21: They will take the calf for the sin offering, and it will be burned in the separated area of the house, outside the holy places.
units.Ezekiel 43:22: On the second day they will take two unblemished goat kids for sin, and they will make atonement for the altar as they made atonement with the calf.
units.Ezekiel 43:23: After you have completed the atonement, they will bring an unblemished calf from the cattle and an unblemished ram from the sheep.
units.Ezekiel 43:24: You all will bring them before the Lord, and the priests will throw salt upon them and offer them as burnt offerings to the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 43:25: For seven days you will prepare a kid for sin each day, and a calf from the cattle and a ram from the sheep. They will prepare unblemished animals—
units.Ezekiel 43:26: —for seven days. They will make atonement for the altar and cleanse it, and they will fill their hands.
units.Ezekiel 43:27: From the eighth day onward, the priests will offer your burnt offerings and your offerings for well-being on the altar. I will accept you, says the Lord.”
units.Ezekiel 44:10: except the Levites, who sprang away from Me when Israel strayed from Me after their reflections; they will receive their injustice—
units.Ezekiel 44:11: —and will serve in My holy places as gatekeepers at the house’s gates and as ministers to the house. They will slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people, and stand before the people to serve them.
units.Ezekiel 44:12: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and it became a punishment of injustice for the house of Israel, I raised My hand against them, says the Lord God.
units.Ezekiel 44:13: They will not draw near to Me to serve Me as priests, nor approach the holy things of the sons of Israel, nor My most holy things. They will receive their dishonor in the straying by which they strayed.
units.Ezekiel 44:14: They will assign them to keep the duties of the house, for all its works and everything they may do.
units.Ezekiel 44:15: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the duties of My holy places when the house of Israel strayed from Me, will approach Me to minister to Me. They will stand before Me to offer sacrifice, fat, and blood to Me, says the Lord God.
units.Ezekiel 44:16: They will enter My holy places and approach My table to minister to Me, and they will keep My duties.
units.Ezekiel 44:17: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they will put on linen robes. They will not wear woolen things when they minister from the gate of the inner court.
units.Ezekiel 44:18: They will have linen turbans on their heads and linen trousers on their hips, and they will not bind their clothing tightly.
units.Ezekiel 44:19: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they will take off the robes in which they minister, place them in the recessed chambers of the holy places, and put on other robes. They will certainly not sanctify the people with their robes.
units.Ezekiel 44:28: This will be their inheritance: I am their inheritance. No possession will be given them among the sons of Israel, because I am their possession.
units.Ezekiel 44:29: They will eat the sacrifices, the offerings for sin, and the offerings for ignorance. Everything set apart in Israel will belong to them.
units.Ezekiel 44:30: The firstfruits of everything, the firstborn of everything, and all the contributions from all your firstfruits will belong to the priests. You will give your first produce to the priest, to place your blessings upon your houses.
units.Numbers 35:1: And the Lord spoke unto Moses on the western side of Moab, beside the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying:
units.Numbers 35:2: Instruct the sons of Israel to give the Levites towns to live in from their allotted possessions. They shall also give the Levites the outlying lands around the towns.
units.Numbers 35:3: And the towns shall be theirs to live in, and their designated lands shall be for their livestock and all their four-footed animals.
units.Numbers 35:4: And the lands adjoining the towns that you shall give the Levites shall extend two thousand cubits outward from the town wall all around.
units.Numbers 35:5: And you shall measure outside the town two thousand cubits on the eastern side, and two thousand cubits on the southwestern side, and two thousand cubits on the seaward side, and two thousand cubits on the northern side; and the town shall be in the midst thereof for you, together with the adjoining lands of the towns.
units.Numbers 35:6: And you shall give the Levites the six cities of refuge that you shall provide for the person who has killed someone to flee to, and in addition to these, forty-two towns.
units.Numbers 35:7: All the towns you shall give the Levites shall be forty-eight towns, together with their outlying lands.
units.Numbers 35:8: And for the towns that you shall give from the possession of the sons of Israel, take many from those with much and fewer from those with less. Each shall give towns to the Levites according to the inheritance he receives.
units.Numbers 18:8: And the Lord spoke unto Aaron: And I, behold, have given you charge of the firstfruits; from all things sanctified unto Me by the sons of Israel, I have given them unto you for a share of honour, and unto your sons after you, an everlasting ordinance.
units.Numbers 18:9: And this shall be yours from the consecrated holy offerings: from all their gifts, and from all their sacrifices, and from every guilt offering of theirs, and from all their sin offerings which they render unto Me; from all the holy things it shall be yours and your sons’.
units.Numbers 18:10: You shall eat them in the most holy place; every male shall eat them, you and your sons; they shall be holy unto you.
units.Numbers 18:11: And this shall be yours, the firstfruits of their gifts: from all the presentations of the sons of Israel, I have given them unto you, and unto your sons and unto your daughters with you, an everlasting ordinance. Everyone clean in your house shall eat them.
units.Numbers 18:12: Every firstfruit of oil, and every firstfruit of wine and grain, their firstfruits which they give unto the Lord, I have given them unto you.
units.Numbers 18:13: All the first produce in their land, which they bring unto the Lord, shall be yours; everyone clean in your house shall eat it.
units.Numbers 18:14: Everything devoted among the sons of Israel shall be yours.
units.Numbers 18:15: And everything that opens the womb of all flesh, which they present unto the Lord, from man unto livestock, shall be yours; but the firstborn of men shall surely be redeemed, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean livestock.
units.Numbers 18:16: And its redemption shall be from one month old; the valuation is five shekels by the holy shekel, which is twenty obols.
units.Numbers 18:17: But you shall not redeem the firstborn of calves, and the firstborn of sheep, and the firstborn of goats; they are holy. And you shall pour their blood against the altar, and you shall offer up the fat as an offering of sweet savour unto the Lord.
units.Numbers 18:18: And their flesh shall be yours; as the breast of the presentation and the right foreleg, it shall be yours.
units.Numbers 18:19: Every portion of the holy things which the sons of Israel set apart unto the Lord I have given unto you, and unto your sons and unto your daughters with you, an everlasting ordinance; it is a covenant of everlasting salt before the Lord for you and for your seed after you.
units.Leviticus 25:23: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine; for you are resident foreigners and lodgers before Me;
units.Leviticus 25:24: and throughout all the land of your possession, you shall provide redemption for the land.
units.Leviticus 25:25: But if your brother who is with you becomes poor, and sells some of his possession, and his nearest kinsman comes, he shall redeem that which his brother sold.
units.Leviticus 25:26: If someone has no kinsman but prospers by his hand and enough is found for his redemption,
units.Leviticus 25:27: then he shall calculate the years of his sale and repay the excess to the man to whom he sold himself; then he shall depart to his possession.
units.Leviticus 25:28: If his hand does not prosper enough to repay him, the sale shall remain with the one who acquired it until the sixth year of release. It shall go out at the release, and he shall depart to his possession.
units.Leviticus 25:29: But if anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, its redemption shall be possible until a year of days is fulfilled; that shall be its redemption period.
units.Leviticus 25:30: If it is not redeemed before its whole year is complete, the house in the city that has a wall shall be confirmed permanently to its buyer throughout his generations. It shall not go out at the release.
units.Leviticus 25:31: But houses in settlements that have no surrounding wall shall be reckoned with the field of the land. They shall always be redeemable and shall go out at the release.
units.Leviticus 25:32: And the cities of the Levites—the houses in their cities of possession—shall always be redeemable by the Levites.
units.Leviticus 25:33: And whosoever redeems from the Levites, the sale of their houses in the city of their possession shall go out at the release; for the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel.
units.Leviticus 25:34: And the fields set apart for their cities shall not be sold, for this is their everlasting possession.
units.Leviticus 19:33: If a resident foreigner comes to you in your land, you shall not oppress him.
units.Leviticus 19:34: The resident foreigner who approaches you shall be as the native among you; and you shall love him as yourself, for you were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
units.Leviticus 19:35: You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measures, weights, or scales.
units.Leviticus 19:36: You shall have just scales, just weights, and a just chous. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
units.Leviticus 19:37: And you shall keep all My law and all My ordinances, and do them; I am the Lord your God.
units.Deuteronomy 25:13: You shall not have in your pouch differing weights, a great and a small.
units.Deuteronomy 25:14: You shall not have in your house differing measures, a great and a small.
units.Deuteronomy 25:15: You shall have a true and just weight, and you shall have a true and just measure, that your days may be long upon the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession.
units.Deuteronomy 25:16: For everyone who does these things, everyone who does injustice, is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
units.Exodus 30:11: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
units.Exodus 30:12: “When you number the sons of Israel in their visitation, each shall give the Lord a ransom for his soul, and no downfall shall come among them in their visitation.
units.Exodus 30:13: This is what all who pass into the numbering shall give: half a didrachma, according to the holy didrachma. Twenty obols make the didrachma, and half a didrachma shall be the contribution to the Lord.
units.Exodus 30:14: Everyone counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the contribution to the Lord.
units.Exodus 30:15: The rich shall give no more and the poor no less than half a didrachma when giving the contribution to the Lord to make propitiation for your lives.
units.Exodus 30:16: Receive the contribution silver from the sons of Israel and assign it to the work of the Tent of Testimony. It shall be a memorial for the sons of Israel before the Lord, to make propitiation for your lives.”
units.Exodus 16:36: An omer was one-tenth of the three measures.
units.Leviticus 27:30: Every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land and the fruit of trees, belongs unto the Lord; it is holy unto the Lord.
units.Leviticus 27:31: But if a man indeed redeems his tithe, he shall add a fifth part unto it, and it shall be his.
units.Leviticus 27:32: And every tithe of cattle and sheep, and everything that comes under the staff in the count—the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.
units.Leviticus 27:33: You shall not exchange a good one for a bad one; but if you do indeed exchange it, its substitute also shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
units.2 Chronicles 31:1: When all these things were finished, all Israel present in Judah’s cities went out. They shattered the pillars, cut down the sacred groves, and demolished the high places and altars throughout Judea and Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasse, to completion. Then all Israel returned, each to his inheritance and their cities.
units.2 Chronicles 31:2: Hezekiah arranged the divisions of priests and Levites, and each one’s divisions according to his own ministry, priests and Levites for the burnt offering and the sacrifice of salvation, to praise, give thanks, and minister at the gates in the courtyards of the Lord’s house.
units.2 Chronicles 31:3: The king’s portion from his belongings was for the morning and evening burnt offerings and burnt offerings for Sabbaths, new moons, and the festivals written in the Lord’s law.
units.2 Chronicles 31:4: He told the people living in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and Levites, so that they could be strong in the ministry of the Lord’s house.
units.2 Chronicles 31:5: When he commanded the matter, the sons of Israel increased the firstfruits of grain, wine, oil, honey, and every crop of the field. They brought all the tithes abundantly—
units.2 Chronicles 31:6: the sons of Israel and Judah. Those living in Judah’s cities also brought tithes of calves and sheep and tithes of goats, consecrated them to the Lord their God, brought them in, and laid heaps upon heaps.
units.Jeremiah 22:1: Thus says the Lord: Go and descend to the house of Judah’s king and speak this word there,
units.Jeremiah 22:2: and say: Hear the Lord’s word, king of Judah who sits on David’s throne—you, your household, your people, and those entering these gates.
units.Jeremiah 22:3: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness; rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him. Do not oppress the newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not act impiously or shed innocent blood in this place.
units.Jeremiah 22:4: Because if you truly carry out this word, kings sitting upon David’s throne and riding chariots and horses will enter this house’s gates—they, their servants, and their people.
units.Jeremiah 22:5: But if you do not carry out these words, I swear by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.
units.Leviticus 16:6: And Aaron shall present the calf for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his house.
units.Leviticus 16:7: And he shall take the two male young goats and present them before the Lord beside the door of the Tent of Testimony.
units.Leviticus 16:8: And Aaron shall place upon the two male young goats one lot for the Lord and one lot for the one sent away.
units.Leviticus 16:9: And Aaron shall present the male young goat on which the lot for the Lord fell and offer it for sin.
units.Leviticus 16:10: And he shall present alive before the Lord the male young goat on which the lot of the one sent away fell, to make atonement over it, so as to send it away for removal. He shall release it into the wilderness.
units.Leviticus 16:11: And Aaron shall present the calf for the sin offering of himself and his house alone, make atonement for himself and his house, and slaughter the calf for his own sin offering.
units.Leviticus 16:12: And he shall take the firepan full of burning coals from the altar opposite the Lord, fill his hands with finely compounded incense, and bring them within the veil,
units.Leviticus 16:13: and put the incense on the fire before the Lord. The vapour of incense shall cover the propitiatory cover above the testimonies, and he shall not die.
units.Leviticus 16:14: And he shall take some of the calf’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the propitiatory cover toward the east; before the propitiatory cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
units.Leviticus 16:15: And he shall slaughter the male young goat for the people’s sin offering before the Lord and bring some of its blood within the veil. He shall do with its blood as he did with the calf’s blood, sprinkling its blood on the propitiatory cover, before the propitiatory cover,
units.Leviticus 16:16: and make atonement for the holy place from the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses and their wrongdoings, concerning all their sins. He shall do the same for the Tent of Testimony established among them amid their uncleanness.
units.Leviticus 16:17: And no one shall be in the Tent of Testimony when he enters to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out. He shall make atonement for himself, his house, and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel.
units.Leviticus 16:18: And he shall go out unto the altar opposite the Lord and make atonement upon it. He shall take some of the calf’s blood and some of the male young goat’s blood and put it all around on the altar’s horns,
units.Leviticus 16:19: and he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, cleanse it, and consecrate it from the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses.
units.Leviticus 16:20: And he shall finish making atonement for the holy place, the Tent of Testimony, and the altar, and perform cleansing for the priests. He shall present the living male young goat.
units.Leviticus 16:21: And Aaron shall lay his hands on the living male young goat’s head and confess over it all the sons of Israel’s lawless deeds, all their injustices, and all their sins. He shall put them on the living male young goat’s head and send it into the wilderness by the hand of a prepared man.
units.Leviticus 16:22: And the male young goat shall take upon itself their injustices to an inaccessible land, and he shall release the male young goat into the wilderness.
units.Leviticus 16:29: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, humble your souls, and you shall do no work, neither the native nor the resident foreigner who is attached unto you.
units.Leviticus 16:30: For on this day he shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord; and you shall be cleansed.
units.Leviticus 16:31: It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths, a rest unto you; and you shall humble your souls: an everlasting statute.
units.Leviticus 16:32: The priest whom they anoint and whose hands they consecrate to serve as priest after his father shall make atonement. He shall put on the linen robe, a holy robe,
units.Leviticus 16:33: and he shall make atonement for the Holy of Holies, and for the Tent of Testimony and the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests and for the whole congregation shall he make atonement.
units.Leviticus 16:34: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins; it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord directed Moses.
units.Hebrews 5:1: For every high priest taken from among people is appointed on behalf of people in matters concerning God, to offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
units.Hebrews 5:2: He can deal gently with those who are ignorant and wandering, since he too is surrounded by weakness,
units.Hebrews 5:3: and because of it he is obliged to make offerings for sins on his own behalf, just as on behalf of the people.
units.Hebrews 5:4: And no one takes the honor for himself, but receives it when called by God, just as Aaron was.
units.Numbers 28:1: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
units.Numbers 28:2: Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them, saying: You shall take care to present My gifts, My donations, My offerings of sweet savour unto Me at My feasts.
units.Numbers 28:3: And you shall say unto them: These are the offerings which you shall bring unto the Lord: two unblemished year-old lambs each day for a continual whole burning;
units.Numbers 28:4: you shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the second lamb toward evening.
units.Numbers 28:5: And you shall prepare a tenth of an oiphi of fine flour for a sacrifice, mixed with oil, a fourth of a hin.
units.Numbers 28:6: It is a continual whole burnt offering, instituted at Mount Sinai as a sweet savour unto the Lord.
units.Numbers 28:7: And its drink offering shall be a fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink unto the Lord.
units.Numbers 28:8: And you shall offer the second lamb toward evening; you shall prepare it according to its sacrifice and according to its drink offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
units.Numbers 28:9: And on the Sabbath day you shall bring two unblemished year-old lambs, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and a drink offering,
units.Numbers 28:10: a Sabbath whole burnt offering on each Sabbath, besides the continual whole burning and its drink offering.
units.Numbers 28:11: And at the new moons you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord: two calves from the cattle, and one ram, and seven unblemished year-old lambs;
units.Numbers 28:12: For each calf, three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil; for each ram, two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil;
units.Numbers 28:13: For each lamb, a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil: a sacrifice, a sweet savour, an offering unto the Lord.
units.Numbers 28:14: Their drink offering shall be wine: half a hin for each calf, a third of a hin for each ram, and a quarter of a hin for each lamb. This is the whole burnt offering month by month throughout the year.
units.Numbers 28:15: And one male goat from the goats for sin unto the Lord; besides the continual whole burning shall it be offered, and its drink offering.
units.Numbers 28:16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Lord's Passover.
units.Numbers 28:17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival. You shall eat unleavened bread for seven days.
units.Numbers 28:18: And the first day shall be a holy appointed assembly for you. You shall do no laborious work.
units.Numbers 28:19: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings, offerings unto the Lord: two calves from the cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished for you.
units.Numbers 28:20: And their sacrifice shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each calf and two tenths for each ram.
units.Numbers 28:21: You shall prepare a tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs;
units.Numbers 28:22: And offer one male goat for sin, to make atonement for you,
units.Numbers 28:23: besides the continual morning whole burning, which is a continual whole burnt offering.
units.Numbers 28:24: These you shall prepare in this manner each day for seven days, a gift, an offering of sweet savour unto the Lord; besides the continual whole burnt offering you shall prepare its drink offering.
units.Numbers 28:25: And the seventh day shall be a holy summoned assembly for you. You shall do no laborious work on it.
units.Leviticus 23:4: These are the feasts for the Lord, holy convocations, which you shall proclaim at their proper times.
units.Leviticus 23:5: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, is the Lord’s Passover.
units.Leviticus 23:6: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the Feast of Unleavened Bread unto the Lord. You shall eat unleavened bread for seven days.
units.Leviticus 23:7: And on the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:8: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord for seven days. The seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:33: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
units.Leviticus 23:34: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the Feast of Tents unto the Lord for seven days.
units.Leviticus 23:35: And on the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:36: For seven days you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord. The eighth day shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall bring whole burnt offerings unto the Lord. It is a closing observance; you shall do no laborious work.
units.Leviticus 23:37: These are the feasts for the Lord, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present offerings unto the Lord: whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices and their drink offerings, each day’s requirement on its day,
units.Leviticus 23:38: besides the Lord’s Sabbaths, besides your gifts, besides all your vows, and besides your freewill offerings that you give unto the Lord.
units.Leviticus 23:39: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, when you finish gathering the produce of the land, you shall celebrate unto the Lord for seven days. On the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.
units.Leviticus 23:40: And on the first day you shall take beautiful fruit of a tree, and palm fronds, and dense branches of a tree, and willows, and branches of the chaste tree from a stream, to rejoice before the Lord your God seven days
units.Leviticus 23:41: of the year. This is an everlasting ordinance throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
units.Leviticus 23:42: You shall dwell in tents seven days; every native in Israel shall dwell in tents,
units.Leviticus 23:43: so that your generations may see that I made the sons of Israel dwell in tents when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
units.Exodus 29:38: This is what you shall offer on the altar: two year-old lambs without blemish each day continually, a continual offering.
units.Exodus 29:39: Offer one lamb in the morning and the second in the evening.
units.Exodus 29:40: With one lamb offer a tenth measure of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of beaten oil, and a quarter hin of wine as a libation.
units.Exodus 29:41: Offer the second lamb in the evening, with the same sacrifice and libation as in the morning, as a fragrant aroma, an offering to the Lord,
units.Exodus 29:42: as a continual sacrifice throughout your generations, at the doors of the Tent of Testimony before the Lord, where I will be made known to you, to speak to you.
units.Leviticus 25:10: And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim release throughout the land unto all who dwell therein; this shall be a year of release, a signal unto you; and each one shall depart unto his possession, and each of you shall depart unto his ancestral homeland.
units.Leviticus 25:11: This is a signal of release: the fiftieth year shall be a year for you. You shall not sow, reap what grows of itself, or gather its consecrated produce.
units.Leviticus 25:12: For it is a signal of release; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the fields.
units.Leviticus 25:13: In the year of release, at its signal, each shall return to his possession.
units.Nehemiah 13:15: In those days I saw people in Jouda treading winepresses on the Sabbath, bringing sheaves and loading them on donkeys, with wine, grapes, figs and every kind of burden, bringing them to Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. I warned them on the day of their selling.
units.Nehemiah 13:16: People lived there bringing fish and every kind of merchandise, selling on the Sabbath to the sons of Jouda and in Jerusalem.
units.Nehemiah 13:17: I contended with the free men of Jouda and said to them, “What is this evil thing you are doing, profaning the Sabbath day?
units.Nehemiah 13:18: “Did not your fathers do this, so that our God brought all these evils upon them and upon us and upon this city? Yet you add wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”
units.Nehemiah 13:19: When the gates of Jerusalem were at rest before the Sabbath, I gave orders and they closed the gates. I ordered that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I stationed some of my young servants at the gates so that no burdens would be carried on the Sabbath day.
units.Nehemiah 13:20: They all lodged and conducted sales outside Jerusalem once or twice.
units.Nehemiah 13:21: I testified against them and said, “Why are you lodging opposite the wall? If you do it a second time, I will stretch out my hand against you.” From that time they did not come on the Sabbath.
units.Nehemiah 13:22: I told the Levites who were purifying themselves and coming to guard the gates to sanctify the Sabbath day. In these things remember me, O God, and spare me according to the abundance of Thy mercy.
units.Isaiah 66:23: Month after month and Sabbath after Sabbath, all flesh will come before Me to bow down in Jerusalem,’ said the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 44:1: He brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the holy places, which faced east, and it was shut.
units.Ezekiel 44:2: The Lord said to me, “This gate will remain shut. It will not be opened, and no one will pass through it, because the Lord, the God of Israel, will enter through it. It will remain shut,
units.Ezekiel 44:3: for the ruler—he will sit in it to eat bread before the Lord. He will enter by the way of the gate’s porch and go out by his way.”
units.Micah 2:1: They became people planning troubles and working evil on their beds, and at daybreak they carried them out, because they did not raise their hands to God.
units.Micah 2:2: They coveted fields and plundered orphans, oppressed houses and plundered a man and his house, a man and his inheritance.
units.Numbers 34:1: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
units.Numbers 34:2: Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: You are entering the land of Canaan; this shall be your inheritance, the land of Canaan with its boundaries.
units.Numbers 34:3: And your southwestern side shall run from the wilderness of Sin to the territory adjoining Edom. Your southwestern boundary shall begin from the part of the Salt Sea toward the east.
units.Numbers 34:4: And the boundary shall turn around you from the southwest toward the Ascent of Akrabin and pass through Senna. Its endpoint shall be southwest of Kadesh-barnea; it shall extend to the settlement of Arad and pass through Azmon.
units.Numbers 34:5: And the boundary shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt, and its endpoint shall be the sea.
units.Numbers 34:6: And for your sea boundary, the Great Sea shall mark the limit. This shall be your sea boundary.
units.Numbers 34:7: And this shall be your boundary toward the north: from the Great Sea you shall measure out for yourselves beside the mountain, the mountain;
units.Numbers 34:8: and from the mountain, the mountain, you shall measure out for them toward the entrance into Hamath; and its endpoint shall be the boundaries of Sarada.
units.Numbers 34:9: And the boundary shall extend to Dephrona, and its endpoint shall be Hazar-enan. This shall be your northern boundary.
units.Numbers 34:10: And you shall measure out for yourselves the eastern boundary from Hazar-enan unto Shepham.
units.Numbers 34:11: And the boundary shall descend from Shepham to Arbela, from the east toward the springs. The boundary shall descend to Bela, along the eastern ridge of the Sea of Chennara.
units.Numbers 34:12: And the boundary shall descend to the Jordan, and its endpoint shall be the Salt Sea. This shall be your land and its surrounding boundaries.
units.Numbers 34:13: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying: This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, as the Lord prescribed unto Moses to give to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
units.Numbers 34:14: For the tribe of the sons of Reuben and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to their ancestral houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, have received their allotments.
units.Numbers 34:15: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their allotments across the Jordan opposite Jericho, from the south toward the east.
units.Numbers 33:50: And the Lord spoke unto Moses on the western side of Moab, beside the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying:
units.Numbers 33:51: Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: You are crossing the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
units.Numbers 33:52: and you shall destroy all who inhabit the land before you, remove their lookout places, destroy all their cast idols, and remove all their pillars.
units.Numbers 33:53: And you shall destroy all who inhabit the land and settle in it, for I have given you their land as an allotment.
units.Numbers 33:54: And you shall inherit their land by lot according to your tribes. Increase the possession of the larger groups and decrease that of the smaller groups. Wherever his name comes out shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your ancestral houses.
units.Numbers 33:55: But if you do not destroy the inhabitants of the land from before you, those whom you leave will become splinters in your eyes and missiles in your sides, and they will act as enemies in the land where you shall settle.
units.Numbers 33:56: And then I will do to you what I had determined to do to them.
units.Exodus 6:6: Go, say to the sons of Israel: ‘I am the Lord. I will bring you out from the Egyptians’ domination and deliver you from slavery. I will ransom you with an uplifted arm and with great judgment.
units.Exodus 6:7: And I will take you to Myself for a people, and I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from the oppression of the Egyptians.
units.Exodus 6:8: I will bring you into the land concerning which I stretched out My hand to give it to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as an inheritance. I am the Lord.’”
units.Joshua 19:1: The second lot came out for the sons of Simeon, and their inheritance lay amid the lots of the sons of Judah.
units.Joshua 19:2: Their lot was Beer-sheba, Samaa, and Koladam,
units.Joshua 19:6: Batharoth and their fields: thirteen cities, with their villages.
units.Joshua 19:7: Eremmon, Thalcha, Ether, and Ashan: four cities, with their villages
units.Joshua 19:8: around their cities as far as Barek, going toward Bameth on the southwest. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their divisions.
units.Joshua 19:9: The inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon came from Judah’s lot, because the portion of the sons of Judah was larger than theirs. So the sons of Simeon inherited amid their lot.
units.Joshua 19:10: The third lot came out for Zebulun according to their divisions. The borders of their inheritance shall be Esedek,
units.Joshua 19:11: Gola; their borders are the sea and Maragella. It shall join Beth-arabah at the ravine facing Jekman.
units.Joshua 19:12: It turned back from Seddouk opposite the east, to Bethsamys at the borders of Chaselothaith; it will pass to Daberoth and ascend to Phangai.
units.Joshua 19:13: From there it will turn opposite the east toward Gebere, toward the city of Katasem, and pass to Remmona, Amathar, Aoza.
units.Joshua 19:14: The boundary will turn on the north toward Amoth, and their endpoint shall be Gaiphael,
units.Joshua 19:15: with Katanath, Nabaal, Symoon, Jericho, and Bethman.
units.Joshua 19:16: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun according to their divisions—cities and their villages.
units.Joshua 19:24: The fifth lot came out for Asher.
units.Joshua 19:25: Their borders extended from Eleketh, Aleph, Baithok, and Keaph,
units.Joshua 19:26: and Elimelech, Amiel, and Maasa; it shall join Carmel toward the sea, and Sion and Labanath.
units.Joshua 19:27: It shall turn from the sunrise to Bethegeneth and join Zebulun, and from Gai and Phtaiel on the north the boundary shall enter Saphthaibaithme and Inael and pass to Choba Masomel,
units.Joshua 19:28: and Elbon, Raab, Ememaon, and Kanthan, as far as Sidon the Great.
units.Joshua 19:29: The boundary shall turn to Ramah and as far as the spring of Masphassat and the Tyrians; the boundary shall turn to Jasiph, and its endpoint shall be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,
units.Joshua 19:31: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their divisions—cities and their villages.
units.Joshua 19:32: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali.
units.Joshua 19:33: Their borders were Moolam, Mola, Besemiin, Arme, Nabok, and Jephthamai as far as Dodam, and their endpoints were the Jordan.
units.Joshua 19:34: The boundary shall turn toward the sea to Enath Tabor, pass from there to Jakana, join Zebulun on the south and Asher toward the sea, with the Jordan toward the sunrise.
units.Joshua 19:35: The walled cities of the Tyrians were Tyre and Omatha, Daketh and Chinnereth,
units.Joshua 19:37: Kedesh, Assari, and the Spring of Hazor,
units.Joshua 19:38: Keroe, Megala, Arim, Beththame, and Thessamys.
units.Joshua 19:39: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.
units.Joshua 19:40: The seventh lot came out for Dan.
units.Joshua 19:41: Their borders were Sarath and Asa, cities of Sammaus,
units.Joshua 19:46: From the sea, Jerakon was a boundary near Joppa.
units.Joshua 19:47: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their divisions—their cities and their villages.
units.Joshua 19:47a: The sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorites who were pressing them in the hill country. The Amorites did not allow them to descend into the valley and pressed away from them the boundary of their allotted portion.
units.Joshua 19:48: The sons of Judah went and fought against Lachish, captured it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and inhabited it. They called its name Lasendak.
units.Joshua 15:1: The borders of the tribe of Judah according to their divisions extended from the borders of Idumea, from the wilderness of Zin as far as Kadesh toward the southwest.
units.Joshua 15:2: Their borders on the southwest extended to the edge of the Salt Sea, from the ridge stretching toward the southwest,
units.Joshua 15:3: and it passes opposite the ascent of Akrabin, goes around Senna, goes up from the southwest to Kadesh-barnea, goes out to Hezron, ascends to Addara, and goes around the region west of Kadesh.
units.Joshua 15:4: It goes toward Azmon and will pass through as far as the ravine of Egypt; the boundary will end at the sea. These are their borders on the southwest.
units.Joshua 16:5: The borders of the sons of Ephraim according to their divisions were these: the borders of their inheritance on the east were Ataroth and Erok, as far as Upper Beth-horon and Gazara.
units.Joshua 16:6: The boundary will pass toward the sea to Ikasmon, with Therma on the north; it will turn eastward to Thenasa and Sellesa and pass on the east to Janoka,
units.Joshua 16:7: and to Macho and Ataroth and their villages; it will come to Jericho and pass through to the Jordan.
units.Joshua 16:8: From Taphou the boundary will go toward the sea to Chelkana, and their endpoint will be at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their divisions.
units.Joshua 16:9: Also there were cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim amid the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh—all the cities and their villages.
units.Joshua 16:10: Ephraim did not destroy the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. The Canaanites lived in Ephraim to this day, until Pharaoh king of Egypt went up, took it, and set it on fire. They pierced through the Canaanites, Perizzites, and inhabitants of Gezer, and Pharaoh gave it as a dowry to his daughter.
units.Joshua 17:1: The borders belonged to the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, for he was Joseph’s firstborn: to Machir, Manasseh’s firstborn, the father of Gilead—for he was a man of war—in Gilead and Bashan.
units.Joshua 17:2: There was also an allotment for the remaining sons of Manasseh according to their divisions: the sons of Jezer, Kelez, Jeziel, Shechem, Symarim, and Hepher. These were the males according to their divisions.
units.Joshua 17:3: Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters. These were the names of Zelophehad’s daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Egla, Milcah, and Tirzah.
units.Joshua 17:4: They stood before Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the leaders, saying, “God commanded through Moses that an inheritance be given us among our brothers.” A lot was given them by the Lord’s command among their father’s brothers.
units.Joshua 17:5: Their measured allotment fell from Anassa, and the plain of Labek from Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan,
units.Joshua 17:6: because daughters of the sons of Manasseh inherited a lot among their brothers. The land of Gilead belonged to the remaining sons of Manasseh.
units.Joshua 18:11: The lot of the tribe of Benjamin came out first according to their divisions. The borders of their lot extended between Judah and the sons of Joseph.
units.Joshua 18:12: Their borders on the north began at the Jordan. The boundary will ascend along the northern ridge of Jericho, go up the mountain toward the sea, and end at the wilderness district of Bethon.
units.Joshua 18:13: From there the boundary will pass to Luza along its southwestern ridge—that is Bethel—and descend to Maatarothorech, into the hill country southwest of Lower Beth-horon.
units.Joshua 18:14: The boundary will pass and turn on the side facing the sea toward the southwest, from the mountain facing Beth-horon on the southwest, and end at Kiriath-baal—that is Kiriath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah. This is the side toward the sea.
units.Joshua 18:15: The southwestern side began at the edge of Kiriath-baal. The boundary will pass to Gasin, to the spring of the water of Naphtho.
units.Joshua 18:16: The boundary will descend to the edge of the mountain facing the wooded valley of Onnam, at the northern part of Emekraphain. It will descend through Gaienna along the southwestern ridge of the Jebusites and descend to the Spring of Rogel,
units.Joshua 18:17: and will pass to the spring of Bethsamys, pass to Galiloth opposite the ascent of Aithamin, and descend to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben.
units.Joshua 18:18: It will pass along the northern ridge of Beth-arabah and descend
units.Joshua 18:19: to the borders along the northern ridge of Beth-hoglah. The boundary will end at the northern ridge of the Salt Sea, at the edge of the Jordan on the southwest. These are the borders on the southwest.
units.Joshua 18:20: The Jordan shall form the boundary on the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its borders all around, according to their divisions.
units.Leviticus 27:16: If a man consecrates unto the Lord part of the field of his possession, the valuation shall be according to its seed: fifty didrachmas of silver for a kor of barley.
units.Leviticus 27:17: If he consecrates his field from the year of release, it shall stand according to its valuation.
units.Leviticus 27:18: If he consecrates his field later, after the release, the priest shall calculate the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of release, and a deduction shall be made from its assessment.
units.Leviticus 27:19: If the one who consecrated the field redeems it, he shall add a fifth of the silver to its valuation, and it shall be his.
units.Leviticus 27:20: If he does not redeem the field and sells the field to another man, he shall no longer redeem it.
units.Leviticus 27:21: When the release has passed, the field shall be holy unto the Lord like land set apart. It shall become the priest’s possession.
units.Leviticus 27:22: If he consecrates unto the Lord part of a field he acquired, which is not part of the field of his inherited possession,
units.Leviticus 27:23: the priest shall calculate for him the total valuation from the year of release, and he shall repay the valuation on that day as holy unto the Lord.
units.Leviticus 27:24: And in the year of release the field shall be returned to the man from whom he acquired it, whose possession the land was.
units.Ezekiel 40:1: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was captured, on that day the Lord’s hand came upon me, and He led me
units.Ezekiel 40:2: in a vision of God into Israel’s land and set me upon a very high mountain. Upon it, opposite, was something like a city’s structure.
units.Ezekiel 40:3: He brought me in there, and behold, a man whose appearance was like gleaming copper. In his hand were a builders’ cord and a measuring reed, and he stood at the gate.
units.Ezekiel 40:4: The man said to me, ‘Have you seen, son of man? See with your eyes, hear with your ears and set in your heart everything I show you, for you have entered here so that it might be shown to you. You will show Israel’s house everything you see.’
units.Ezekiel 26:2: “Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, ‘Well done! She is shattered; the nations have perished. She has turned to me; the full one has been laid waste,’
units.Ezekiel 26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
units.Ezekiel 26:4: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.
units.Ezekiel 26:5: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,
units.Ezekiel 26:6: and her daughters in the plain will be killed by the sword. They will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 26:12: He will plunder your strength, strip your possessions, throw down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. He will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.
units.Ezekiel 26:13: He will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will certainly no longer be heard.
units.Ezekiel 26:14: I will make you a smooth rock, a drying place for nets. You will certainly not be rebuilt, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
units.2 Kings 2:19: The men of the city said to Elisha, ‘Behold, the city’s settlement is good, as the lord sees, but the waters are bad and the land is bereaved of offspring.’
units.2 Kings 2:20: Elisha said, ‘Bring me a new small water jar and put salt in it.’ They brought it to him.
units.2 Kings 2:21: Elisha went out to the outlet of the waters, threw salt there, and said, ‘Thus says the Lord: I have healed these waters. No longer will death or loss of offspring come from there.’
units.2 Kings 2:22: The waters have remained healed to this day, according to the word Elisha spoke.
units.Genesis 1:20: And God said, “Let the waters bring forth living creatures that move, and birds that fly above the earth across the firmament of heaven.” And it was so.
units.Genesis 1:21: And God made the great sea creatures, and every living creature that moves, which the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that they were good.
units.Genesis 1:22: And God blessed them, saying, “Grow and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas; and let the birds multiply upon the earth.”
units.Genesis 1:23: And there was evening, and there was morning: a fifth day.
units.Psalms 1:1: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of pestilent men;
units.Psalms 1:2: but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night.
units.Psalms 1:3: He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and whose leaf will not fall off; and everything he does will be prospered.
units.Psalms 1:4: Not so the ungodly, not so, but like chaff which the wind flings away from the face of the earth.
units.Psalms 1:5: Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the council of the righteous;
units.Psalms 1:6: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly will perish.
units.Exodus 28:15: You shall make an oracle-piece of judgments, embroidered work, according to the pattern of the shoulder-piece, of gold, blue, purple, spun scarlet yarn, and spun fine linen.
units.Exodus 28:16: It shall be square and doubled, a span long and a span wide.
units.Exodus 28:17: You shall weave into it a fabric set with four rows of stones. The first row shall be a sardius, topaz, and emerald;
units.Exodus 28:18: the second row a carbuncle, sapphire, and jasper;
units.Exodus 28:19: the third row a ligure, agate, and amethyst;
units.Exodus 28:20: the fourth row a chrysolite, beryl, and onyx. They shall be enclosed in gold and bound in gold according to their rows.
units.Exodus 28:21: The stones shall bear the names of the sons of Israel, twelve according to their names, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
units.Exodus 28:22: You shall make braided chains of pure gold for the oracle-piece.
units.Exodus 28:29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel upon the oracle-piece of judgment, upon his breast, when he enters into the sanctuary, as a memorial before God.
units.Numbers 2:1: And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
units.Numbers 2:2: Let the sons of Israel camp, each beside his neighbour, by formation and by the signs of their ancestral houses. The sons of Israel shall camp opposite, around the Tent of Testimony.
units.Numbers 2:3: And those camping first toward the east shall be the formation of Judah’s camp, with their army. The ruler of the sons of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
units.Numbers 2:4: His army, those registered, numbered seventy-four thousand six hundred.
units.Numbers 2:5: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Issachar; the ruler of the sons of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
units.Numbers 2:6: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-four thousand four hundred.
units.Numbers 2:7: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Zebulun; the ruler of the sons of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
units.Numbers 2:8: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
units.Numbers 2:9: All those registered in the camp of Judah, with their army, numbered one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. They shall set out first.
units.Numbers 2:10: The formation of the camp of Reuben, with their army, shall be toward the southwest. The ruler of the sons of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
units.Numbers 2:11: His army, those registered, numbered forty-six thousand five hundred.
units.Numbers 2:12: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Simeon; the ruler of the sons of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
units.Numbers 2:13: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
units.Numbers 2:14: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Gad; the ruler of the sons of Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel.
units.Numbers 2:15: His army, those registered, numbered forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
units.Numbers 2:16: All those registered in the camp of Reuben, with their army, numbered one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty. They shall set out second.
units.Numbers 2:17: And the Tent of Testimony and the camp of the Levites shall be raised in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each beside his neighbour according to command.
units.Numbers 2:18: The formation of the camp of Ephraim, with their army, shall be toward the sea. The ruler of the sons of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.
units.Numbers 2:19: His army, those registered, numbered forty thousand five hundred.
units.Numbers 2:20: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Manasseh; the ruler of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
units.Numbers 2:21: His army, those registered, numbered thirty-two thousand two hundred.
units.Numbers 2:22: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Benjamin; the ruler of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.
units.Numbers 2:23: His army, those registered, numbered thirty-five thousand four hundred.
units.Numbers 2:24: All those registered in the camp of Ephraim, with their army, numbered one hundred eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out third.
units.Numbers 2:25: The formation of the camp of Dan, with their army, shall be toward the north. The ruler of the sons of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
units.Numbers 2:26: His army, those registered, numbered sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
units.Numbers 2:27: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Asher; the ruler of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran.
units.Numbers 2:28: His army, those registered, numbered forty-one thousand five hundred.
units.Numbers 2:29: And those camping next shall be the tribe of Naphtali; the ruler of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.
units.Numbers 2:30: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-three thousand four hundred.
units.Numbers 2:31: All those registered in the camp of Dan numbered one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by their formation.
units.Numbers 2:32: This is the enrolment of the sons of Israel by their ancestral houses. The whole enrolment of the camps, with their armies, was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
units.Numbers 2:33: But the Levites were not registered together with them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
units.Numbers 2:34: And the sons of Israel did everything that the Lord instructed Moses. So they camped by their formations, and so they set out, each beside his neighbour, by their divisions and ancestral houses.
units.Joshua 19:17: The fourth lot came out for Issachar.
units.Joshua 19:18: Their borders included Jazel, Chasaloth, and Shunem,
units.Joshua 19:21: Remmas, Jeon, Tomman, Aimarek, and Bersaphes.
units.Joshua 19:22: The boundary shall join Gaithbor and Salim toward the sea and Bethsamys, and its boundary shall end at the Jordan.
